{{Quote|Everything else from now on should be in Quesoth Common Speak. Which I presume you understand.|[[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], to Grand Admiral Thrawn and Senior Captain Voss Parck|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Quesoth Common Speak''' was one of the two [[Language/Legends|languages]] spoken by the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], the other one being [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]]. The latter language used a completely different vocabulary from Common Speak.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CrisisD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Quesoth spoke the tongue while escorting their [[Queen/Legends|queen]], the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], to the [[Dwelling of Guests]], a building located in Quethold's [[Red City]]. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], two of the [[Empire of the Hand]]'s [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]], understood Common Speak.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quesoth Common Speak appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
